title: Preserve bounded redacted federation SSH failure diagnostics
outcome: The existing federation diagnostic surface exposes bounded redacted SSH termination evidence and current per-peer attempt/park state so an agent can distinguish a fresh fast-failing attempt from historical startup failure or runtime quarantine without reading secrets or changing peer authority.
acceptance: Deterministic child-failure tests expose SSH exit status and a bounded fixed stderr classification through the existing diagnostic owner; the diagnostics distinguish DNS/connect/authentication/host-key/forward or other SSH failure classes to the extent observed, with an explicit unknown class when evidence is insufficient.

Deterministic worker lifecycle tests distinguish a current attempt, ordinary bounded retry, material-change park and runtime quarantine, including current attempt stage/time and its peer/basis attribution; a stale prior-basis startupExpired or lastObserved value is not presented as a fresh attempt.

Negative tests verify strict diagnostic size bounds and redaction: no credential material, pair secret, control/MAC payload, arbitrary request body or unrestricted raw stderr is exposed; child cleanup, no-overlap and every authentication/material/authority fence remain unchanged.
The exact final input passes the required independent review pair and full five-stage gate, with records naming the classified failure, park-state and redaction tests actually executed.
